figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of Min-k% Prob . To determine whether a text X 𝑋 X is in the pretraining data of a LLM such as GPT, Min-k% Prob first gets the probability for each token in X 𝑋 X , selects the k 𝑘 k % tokens with minimum probabilities and calculates their average log likelihood. If the average log likelihood is high, the text is likely in the pretraining data.

Figure 6: Auditing machine unlearning with Min-k% Prob . Machine unlearning methods are designed to remove copyrighted and personal data from large language models. We use Min-k% Prob to audit an unlearned LLM that has been trained to forget copyrighted books. However, we find that such a model can still output related copyrighted content.
